title: Claude.md File in Claude Code
content: Claude.md is a file where you write preferences and settings for your project. It includes information about the tools your project uses, such as React and Postgres, and how you like your code written. There is a global Claude.md in the .cloud folder that applies to all projects, and a project-specific one inside each project folder. This file is automatically generated using a {slash} init command. Claude reads and analyzes the full project and writes the Claude.md file at the start of every session.
